```{r cover-header, include=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
# Write cover-header.tex : eso-pic block with the ABSOLUTE path of the
# cover image, so it compiles identically on Windows and on Linux (CI).
cover_path <- here::here("images", "report", "cover-background.png")
cover_path <- gsub("\\\\", "/", cover_path)
stopifnot(file.exists(cover_path))  # fail early with a clear message

cover_header <- c(
  r"(% ---------------------------------------------------------------)",
  r"(% COVER PAGE : full-page background image + title + subtitle + author)",
  r"(% Generated by Formula1.Rmd - path is absolute, OS-independent)",
  r"(% ---------------------------------------------------------------)",
  r"(\AddToShipoutPictureBG*{%)",
  r"(  % --- Full-page background image ---)",
  r"(  \AtPageLowerLeft{%)",
  paste0(r"(    \includegraphics[width=\paperwidth,height=\paperheight,keepaspectratio=false]{)",
         cover_path,
         r"(}%)"),
  r"(  }%)",
  r"(  % --- Title and subtitle, centered horizontally, upper third of the page ---)",
  r"(  \AtPageCenter{%)",
  r"(    \raisebox{9.5cm}{\makebox(0,0){%)",
  r"(      \color{white}\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{72}{80}\selectfont 1~FORMULA}}%)",
  r"(    \raisebox{7.2cm}{\makebox(0,0){%)",
  r"(      \color{white}\sffamily\fontsize{17}{20}\selectfont One equation. 817 drivers. One answer.}}%)",
  r"(  }%)",
  r"(  % --- Author, discreet, bottom right corner ---)",
  r"(  \AtPageLowerLeft{%)",
  r"(    \raisebox{1.5cm}[0pt][0pt]{%)",
  r"(      \hspace*{\dimexpr\paperwidth-1.2cm\relax}%)",
  r"(      \llap{\color{white}\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11}{12}\selectfont JEAN-MARIE ROY}}%)",
  r"(  }%)",
  r"(})"
)
writeLines(cover_header, "cover-header.tex")
```
